title: Explain responses: compact encoding so Rust and larger programs fit under the caps
description: Rust programs using sort, u128 or {:#x} run 25k-32k instructions and end as output_limit_exceeded (cap 20000 instructions, 4 MB; about 130 bytes of JSON per instruction). Use a function-name table and compact fields to shrink the response, then raise the instruction cap; update the web client.
right_now_summary: Rust programs exceed the 20,000-instruction cap, so response encoding must shrink before the cap is raised.
